weapons.name: Cinder Blade
weapons.description: Hold Attack for a fast three-hit combo. The third strike lunges forward. No reload; attack speed accelerates the full swing. Slash detonates ash on pulled enemies.

weapons.name: Grav Hammer
weapons.description: Hold Attack for left swing, right swing, then a charged jump-slam (2.6x damage). Two-handed grip. No reload. The finisher collapses your nearest well.

weapons.name: Ash Bow
weapons.description: Accurate arrows pass straight through wells. Splits require a Split upgrade and an enemy hit.

weapons.name: Spiral Glaive
weapons.description: Thrown blades orbit a well, cutting enemies inside.

weapons.name: Ember Staff
weapons.description: Mark enemies with ash. Wells burn marks; perfect wells slow.

weapons.name: Rift Scythe
weapons.description: No reload; attack speed accelerates the full scythe swing. Dash through a well for a wide crescent and extra invulnerability.

weapons.name: Cinder Scattergun
weapons.description: Six burning pellets in a tight cone. Devastating nearby; damage falls with distance. One proc-carrying pellet per shot.

weapons.name: Tempest Rotary
weapons.description: Rapid frost rounds. Sustained fire widens the cone; release briefly to recover accuracy.

weapons.name: Rift Mortar
weapons.description: Launch an ember rocket that bursts on contact. Splash respects cover, scales with area upgrades, and cannot hurt allies.

relics.name: Ashen Kindling
relics.description: Wells ignite enemies inside.

relics.name: Borrowed Momentum
relics.description: Dashing through a well refreshes Spiral once per well.

relics.name: Quiet Collapse
relics.description: A collapsing well heals its owner for 5 HP.

relics.name: Faultless Edge
relics.description: First attack after a perfect well is guaranteed critical.

relics.name: Lingering Orbit
relics.description: Up to two wells follow you into the next room for 3 seconds.

relics.name: Party Attunement
relics.description: Your wells accelerate allies' attacks while inside.

relics.name: Second Echo
relics.description: Perfect wells repeat their collapse after a brief delay.

relics.name: Shattered Ring
relics.description: Collapsed wells fire six poison arrows.

relics.name: Twin Singularity
relics.description: Perfect casts plant a second, smaller well.

relics.name: Ash Mantle
relics.description: Releasing Spiral grants a 10-point shield.

relics.name: Cinder Wake
relics.description: Dash trails burn enemies that cross them.

relics.name: Orbiting Remains
relics.description: Wells gain an orbiting blade.

relics.name: Chain Reaction
relics.description: Collapse hastens nearby wells by one second.

relics.name: Blood Gravity
relics.description: Casting below half HP spends 3 HP for a perfect well.

relics.name: Still Ash
relics.description: Wells slow enemies caught inside.

relics.name: Exit Wound
relics.description: Dashing out of a well erupts for 28 damage.

relics.name: Long Spiral
relics.description: Place your well farther along your aim.

relics.name: Patient Gravity
relics.description: Killing a pulled enemy extends its well, capped at 6 seconds.

relics.name: Inner Sanctuary
relics.description: Standing in your well absorbs one hit per cast.

relics.name: Measured Breath
relics.description: Widen the perfect-release timing window.

relics.name: Returning Ash
relics.description: Your projectiles bounce once.

relics.name: Hungry Heart
relics.description: A collapsing well draws health drops to you.

relics.name: Afterimage
relics.description: Dash plants a short-lived well at its origin.

relics.name: Linked Landing
relics.description: Dashing through an ally well shields both players.

active_skills.name: Rune Lance
active_skills.description: 25 Focus / 1.2s. A 48-damage aimed lance; +25% against staff marks. Rune Nova turns the impact into a 300cm area blast. Pairs with Ember Staff.

active_skills.name: Winter Fan
active_skills.description: 30 Focus / 6s. A 650cm forward cone deals 24 damage and builds frost twice. Freeze foes before a hammer slam or line up a bow shot. Bosses resist hard control.

active_skills.name: Storm Thread
active_skills.description: 32 Focus / 5s. Aim at a foe to arc through up to four enemies for 38/29/22/17 damage. +30% against chilled or poisoned targets. Pairs with frost and poison weapons.

active_skills.name: Venom Bloom
active_skills.description: 35 Focus / 7s. Plant a 320cm poison field for 4s. Pulses deal 7 damage and apply poison, or +30% pulse damage against bleeding enemies. Gather with Spiral; finish with ranged attacks.

active_skills.name: War Cry
active_skills.description: 28 Focus / 9s. Stagger nearby foes for 18 damage; gain 22 shield and +20% melee damage for 4s. Pairs with blade, hammer and scythe. No shield or buff between waves.

active_skills.name: Cinder Mine
active_skills.description: 30 Focus / 6s. Place an aimed rune that explodes after 1s for 68 damage in 330cm and ignites survivors. +25% damage to pulled foes. Set a well, then detonate.

spiral_styles.name: Orbit
spiral_styles.description: Every well carries an orbiting blade.

spiral_styles.name: Twin
spiral_styles.description: Main well at full size; second well at 72% size.

spiral_styles.name: Anchor
spiral_styles.description: Long-lived wells with a tighter radius.

spiral_styles.name: Rift
spiral_styles.description: Collapsing wells erupt across a wider area.

spiral_styles.name: Convergence
spiral_styles.description: Perfect wells grant a critical next attack.

core_upgrades.name: Ability Cooldown
core_upgrades.description: -8% of the base Spiral cooldown this run. Stacks with permanent cooldown upgrades; 65% total cap.

core_upgrades.name: Attack Speed
core_upgrades.description: +12% attack speed this run, for every weapon.

core_upgrades.name: Damage
core_upgrades.description: +15% damage this run, including your abilities.

core_upgrades.name: Maximum Health
core_upgrades.description: +15 maximum health and heal 15 HP immediately.

core_upgrades.name: Movement Speed
core_upgrades.description: +5% running speed this run. Dash distance is unchanged.

core_upgrades.name: Critical Chance
core_upgrades.description: +5 percentage points of critical chance this run, up to 50% total.

hearth.name: Ashen Vessel
hearth.description: +8 starting HP per rank.

hearth.name: Ember Shell
hearth.description: +5 starting shield per rank.

hearth.name: Gentle Collapse
hearth.description: Your well collapses heal 1 HP per rank.

hearth.name: Second Breath
hearth.description: Once per run, fatal damage restores 25% HP.

hearth.name: Widening Spiral
hearth.description: +25 cm well radius per rank.

hearth.name: Held Ash
hearth.description: +0.25 seconds well duration per rank.

hearth.name: Measured Release
hearth.description: Perfect window widens 0.025s per rank.

hearth.name: Weight of Names
hearth.description: +45 cm/s pull speed per rank.

hearth.name: Light Step
hearth.description: Dash recharges 0.06s faster per rank.

hearth.name: Ash Body
hearth.description: +0.025s dash invulnerability per rank.

hearth.name: Long Wake
hearth.description: Dash trail lasts 0.2s longer per rank.

hearth.name: Safe Landing
hearth.description: Dash grants at least 0.4s invulnerability.

hearth.name: Another Possibility
hearth.description: Reward chests offer five choices instead of four.

hearth.name: Provision
hearth.description: Start with +10 Cinders per rank.

hearth.name: Ability Cooldown
hearth.description: -10% of the base Spiral cooldown per rank. Total cooldown reduction caps at 65%.

hearth.name: Shared Momentum
hearth.description: Ally-well launch heals 3 HP, once per 3 seconds.

hearth.name: Attack Speed
hearth.description: +8% attack speed per rank. Applies to every weapon.

hearth.name: Damage
hearth.description: +10% damage per rank, including your abilities.

hearth.name: Movement Speed
hearth.description: +5% running speed per rank. Dash distance is unchanged.

hearth.name: Critical Chance
hearth.description: +4 percentage points per rank, from a base 5%. Critical attacks deal 1.8x damage.

talents.name: Second Wind
talents.description: One fatal rescue per run at 30% health.

talents.name: Unbroken
talents.description: Gain a 20% health shield before crossing 25% health; 12s recharge.

talents.name: Rally Step
talents.description: Dash grants nearby allies 10% damage for 3 seconds.

talents.name: Guardian Link
talents.description: A heavy hit within 720cm grants the talent holder a 10% health shield; 12s recharge.

talents.name: Coordinated Strike
talents.description: Alternating ally hits deal +18% damage; +5% solo.

talents.name: Twin Resonance
talents.description: Heal 2% near your ally every 8s; 1% solo.

talents.name: Lucky Find
talents.description: Earn 20% more common materials on room clear.

talents.name: Retired talent
talents.description: Former Treasure Sense. Its skill point is refunded automatically.

talents.name: Spiral Hoarder
talents.description: Victory grants 30 additional Scrap and 10 Bone Dust.

traits.name: Honed Edge
traits.description: +4 base damage per rank; firearms normalize this bonus by fire rate for equal added burst DPS.

traits.name: Deadeye
traits.description: +20 percentage points of critical damage per rank (base 180%).

traits.name: Brawler
traits.description: +12% melee weapon damage per rank.

traits.name: Marksman
traits.description: +12% bow/glaive/firearm weapon damage per rank.

traits.name: Arcanist
traits.description: +12% staff and skill damage per rank.

traits.name: Kindling Touch
traits.description: 18% chance/rank to apply burn (54% before evolution). If the weapon already burns, a proc raises its burn power by 30%.

traits.name: Venom Touch
traits.description: 18% chance/rank to apply poison (54% before evolution). Native poison gains an extra stack and 30% power on a proc.

traits.name: Serrated Touch
traits.description: 18% chance per rank to bleed on a primary hit. Bleed: 4 DPS/stack, 2 stacks, 3 sec.

traits.name: Storm Touch
traits.description: 18% chance per rank to shock for 20% weapon damage and arc to one nearby foe. 0.35 sec limit.

traits.name: Winter Touch
traits.description: 18% chance per rank to add frost on a primary hit; bosses only chill.

traits.name: Drill Shot
traits.description: Primary projectiles pierce one additional enemy per rank.

traits.name: Ricochet
traits.description: Primary projectiles ricochet to one extra enemy or off a wall per rank.

traits.name: Forked Flight
traits.description: 18% chance per rank to split on impact into two 40%-damage shots. Splits cannot split again.

traits.name: Impact Bloom
traits.description: Primary hits splash nearby enemies for 15% dealt damage per rank. 0.25 sec limit; no recursive procs.

traits.name: Elite Hunter
traits.description: +15% damage against elites per rank.

traits.name: Giant Slayer
traits.description: +15% damage against bosses per rank.

traits.name: First Blood
traits.description: +20% damage against an enemy above 99% health per rank.

traits.name: Leech
traits.description: Heal 1.5% of primary-hit damage per rank, capped at 3 HP per 0.25 sec.

traits.name: Reaper's Rest
traits.description: Heal 1.5 HP per rank when you kill a real enemy.

traits.name: Field Dressing
traits.description: Immediately restore 35% maximum health. Can be chosen up to five times per run.

traits.name: Ironweave
traits.description: Reduce incoming damage by 5% per rank. Combined reductions cap at 65%.

traits.name: Defiance
traits.description: After taking damage, gain 10% damage reduction per rank for 3 sec.

traits.name: Renewing Barrier
traits.description: +12 regenerating shield capacity per rank; restores 2 shield/sec/rank after 5 sec without a hit in combat.

traits.name: Elusive
traits.description: 4% evasion chance per rank, capped at 20% before evolution.

traits.name: Briar Mail
traits.description: Return 4 damage per rank to the attacker on a damaging hit; 0.3 sec internal cooldown.

traits.name: Phoenix Oath
traits.description: Survive one lethal hit this run at 35% health with 2 sec of protection.

traits.name: Regrowth
traits.description: Regenerate 1 HP/sec per rank in combat after 3 sec without damage.

traits.name: Afterimage
traits.description: +0.08 sec invulnerability after taking damage per rank.

traits.name: Longstride
traits.description: Dash distance +12% per rank; dash invulnerability +0.03 sec per rank.

traits.name: Second Step
traits.description: +1 dash charge per rank, up to 3 charges. Charges refill in sequence; air dashes per landing match total charge capacity and each still spends a charge.

traits.name: Winter Mantle
traits.description: Chill nearby enemies within 320 + 50 cm/rank. Normal enemies slow 35%; bosses 25%.

traits.name: Heavy Impact
traits.description: Primary hits knock normal enemies back with 120 force/rank; elites receive half force, bosses resist.

traits.name: Concussion
traits.description: 8% stun chance per rank on primary hits: 0.4 sec, 2 sec immunity. Bosses resist.

traits.name: Bramble Bind
traits.description: 10% root chance per rank on primary hits: 0.8 sec, 3 sec immunity. Bosses resist.

traits.name: Gravity Hook
traits.description: Primary hits pull nearby normal enemies toward the impact. 0.6 sec limit.

traits.name: Repulsor
traits.description: Dashing pushes nearby normal enemies away. Radius 280 + 40 cm/rank.

traits.name: Prospector
traits.description: +20% Cinders from kills per rank, using fractional carry so small kills benefit.

traits.name: Fortune
traits.description: +6 percentage points to health/shield drop chance per rank.

traits.name: Loaded Dice
traits.description: Gain one personal reward reroll immediately. Up to three picks per run.

traits.name: Mending Coin
traits.description: Picking up a Cinder shard restores 1 HP per rank during combat.

traits.name: Vanguard
traits.description: Next and later rooms begin with +10% damage/rank for the first 8 combat seconds.

traits.name: Razor Dash
traits.description: Dash through enemies for 12 damage/rank, once per enemy per dash.

traits.name: Chain Lightning
traits.description: Primary hits chain to one additional enemy per rank at 30% dealt damage, once per 0.35 sec.

traits.name: Patient Hunter
traits.description: After standing still for 1.2 sec, gain +12% damage per rank.

traits.name: Momentum
traits.description: +8% damage per rank while moving faster than a walk.

traits.name: Last Ember
traits.description: +15% damage per rank below 40% health.

traits.name: Battle Rhythm
traits.description: Kills reduce Spiral cooldown by 0.25 sec/rank and grant +5% damage/rank for 2 sec.

traits.name: Echo Shot
traits.description: Fire one additional projectile at 45% damage. Extra shots do not create more splits or proc chains.

traits.name: Fan of Sparks
traits.description: Fire one extra spread projectile per rank at 35% damage each.

traits.name: Expanding Force
traits.description: +15% explosion, Spiral and aura radius per rank.

traits.name: Lingering Affliction
traits.description: +20% burn, poison and bleed duration per rank. Hard crowd-control durations remain capped.

traits.name: Deep Reservoir
traits.description: +10 maximum Focus per rank; immediately restore that amount. Rune Lance uses 25 Focus.

traits.name: Flowing Runes
traits.description: +2 Focus regeneration/sec per rank during combat or lobby practice.

traits.name: Rune Nova
traits.description: Evolve any active skill: Lance and Storm impacts gain a 300 cm blast; Winter Fan gains a 300 cm impact bloom. War Cry, Venom Bloom and Cinder Mine gain 300 cm base radius. Damage per hit is unchanged; area upgrades apply once.

traits.name: Orbiting Ember
traits.description: Gain an orbiting wisp per rank (max 3), each dealing 4 damage every 0.5 sec to a nearby enemy.

traits.name: Vault Sense
traits.description: Show trap positions and timing on the HUD and minimap, plus the optional vault cache.

traits.name: Second Dawn
traits.description: Immediately heal to full. One pick per run.

traits.name: Cleanse
traits.description: Remove all Blood Pact curse stacks (+10% incoming damage each). The traded maximum health stays traded.

traits.name: Blood Pact
traits.description: Trade 15% maximum health for +45% damage. Gain a removable curse: +10% incoming damage.

traits.name: Emberforge Evolution
traits.description: Evolve one owned non-instant trait, granting one effective rank above its normal value. Two evolutions per run.

traits.name: Mystery Relic
traits.description: Gain one random, unowned relic from your unlocked pool. One pick per run.

traits.name: Echo of Choice
traits.description: Repeat your most recent repeatable stat/trait upgrade if it is not capped. One pick per run.

traits.name: Battle Conduit
traits.description: Every 6 primary hits restores 12 Focus and shortens Spiral cooldown by 0.3 sec. Counts at most once per 0.15 sec.

traits.name: Deep Magazine
traits.description: Add 20% of base ammunition/charge capacity per rank, rounding each rank up to whole rounds. Five ranks. Every pick adds at least one round; applies to ranged weapons only. Melee has no reload. Cannot evolve.

traits.name: Quick Hands
traits.description: +15% reload speed per rank. Reload time = base time / (1 + 0.15 x rank). Ranged weapons only. Five ranks; cannot evolve.

traits.name: Tight Grouping
traits.description: 15% less spread per rank, up to 75%. Tightens pellets, rotary fire, Echo Shot, Fan of Sparks and Forked Flight. Cannot evolve.

achievements.name: Ash Hunter
achievements.description: Defeat enemies with your attacks or ongoing effects.

achievements.name: Untouched
achievements.description: Clear a chamber without health or shield damage.

achievements.name: Vaultkeeper
achievements.description: Recover Rune Vault caches with your party.

achievements.name: Alchemist
achievements.description: Defeat enemies affected by at least two statuses.

achievements.name: Quick Work
achievements.description: Clear a chamber within 90 seconds, including countdowns.
